findings.rule: mcp/ package boundary — never touch Drizzle/the DB (SKILL rule 8)
findings.explanation: An MCP tool imports drizzle-orm plus the server's db client and schema and runs SQL queries directly against Postgres. mcp/ is defined as a thin HTTP client of the REST API: it must never import server/ code and never touch the database, which is server infrastructure reachable only inside the server's own layering.
findings.fix: Fetch conventions over HTTP via the shared ApiClient (e.g. client.get('/repos/{owner}/{repo}/conventions')); if the API does not expose this data, add a new API endpoint on the server rather than querying the DB from mcp/.

findings.rule: mcp/ package boundary — never import server code (SKILL rule 8)
findings.explanation: An MCP tool imports the server's Container and ReviewsService and calls the application layer in-process, bypassing the REST API entirely. This also re-creates the composition root outside server/ — the Container is a server-side concept that only server/src/platform/container.ts may wire, and it does not apply inside mcp/.
findings.fix: Replace the in-process service call with an HTTP call through ApiClient to the reviews endpoint (e.g. GET the latest run's findings for the PR), adding a new API endpoint if one does not exist.
